title: RenderedPlaces
description:
The places a scan reads, in words, for showing them before anything is
read and for changing them later.

confirmed.description: Whether the user has agreed to these places before.

managers.description:
The mod managers Mod Mallet can read, and which one the places are
for (ADR 0064). Filled in by the caller, which knows the machine.

places.description:
The places, each with its role and origin in words. A place with an
empty path could not be found and has to be named by the user.

KnownInstance.description: An instance of a mod manager: one setup it manages, in a folder.

portable.description: Whether it is portable: kept anywhere, beside the program.

KnownManager.description: A mod manager Mod Mallet can read.

found.description:
Whether it was found on this machine, without opening any of its
files.

instances.description:
Its instances that were found, for a manager that has them (Mod
Organizer 2). Portable instances are only known if the user named
one.

link.description:
Whether Mod Mallet can hand it actions through a link. Without one,
actions are described for the user to make by hand.

name.description: Its name, as it calls itself.

LocationOrigin.description: How Mod Mallet came to look at a place.

oneOf.description:
It was read from the entry the game's launcher writes into the
Windows registry.

It is the place where the game or the mod manager always puts this
file.
It was found in one of Steam's game libraries.

It was read from the entry GOG Galaxy writes into the Windows
registry.
It is named in the mod manager's record of the files it deployed.
It is named in the mod manager's own settings.

LocationRole.description: What a place the scan looked at is for.

oneOf.description: The directory the game is installed in.
The game's list of active plugins.
The log of the script extender.
The mod manager's saved state: installed mods and installer choices.
The directory the mod manager keeps downloaded mod archives in.
The program used to look into mod archives.
The mod manager's record of the files it deployed.

The list of community-maintained rules about plugins, the LOOT
masterlist.
A folder crash loggers write their reports to.

The folder the mod manager keeps every installed mod's files in,
deployed or not. Only the names of the files are read.

The instance of a mod manager that keeps its settings in a folder
of their own, Mod Organizer 2: its settings, the profile in use and
what it knows about each mod (ADR 0064).

The folder of a mod manager that leaves the files in each mod's
folder, Mod Organizer 2. The game sees them there, so the files the
game would read are read there (ADR 0064).

ManagerChoice.description:
The mod managers Mod Mallet knows, which of them are on this machine,
and which one looks after the game the user looks at.

active.description:
The manager in use, by its identifier: the one the user chose, or
else the one suggested.

chosen.description: Whether the user chose it. If not, it is a suggestion.

managers.description: Every manager Mod Mallet can read.

RenderedLocation.description: A place the scan looked at, with its role and origin in words.

originLabel.description: How Mod Mallet came to look there.

ScanLocation.description: A place the scan looked at, so that nobody has to wonder what was read.

found.description: Whether something was there to read.

origin.description: How Mod Mallet came to look there.
